interface.name: LeadA
interface.description: TRUE selects A as preferred pump

scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.
safety_priority: Prefer selected lead, then healthy fallback

formal_properties.explanation: A cannot run without demand or with its fault.
B cannot run without demand or with its fault.
A is selected when it is the healthy lead.
B is selected when it is the healthy lead.
Toggle once on a served demand's falling edge.
Unserved episodes and held demand preserve preference.
